description: This file contains unit tests for the Basket entity in the application core. It verifies the correctness of the TotalItems property, ensuring it correctly sums the quantities of items added to the basket.

classes.name: BasketTotalItems
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the `TotalItems` property in the `Basket` class.

methods.name: ReturnsTotalQuantityWithOneItem
methods.description: Tests that the TotalItems property correctly returns the quantity when a single item is added to the basket.

methods.name: ReturnsTotalQuantityWithMultipleItems
methods.description: Tests that the TotalItems property correctly returns the sum of quantities when multiple items are added to the basket.
